in_hindi.name: मन्मथ
in_hindi.meaning: मन (man) + मथ (math) = mind + emotion = प्रेम (prem) = infatuation, love, affection
in_hindi.long_meaning: मनस् (manas) + मथ् (matha) = mind + emotion = प्रेम (prem) = infatuation, love, affection

in_marathi.name: Manmath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manmath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manmath is the name of the Hindu god of love and desire. He is believed to control the emotions of love and infatuation. According to Hindu mythology, he is depicted as a god with a red face, carrying a bow and arrow, and surrounded by a cloud of intoxicating fragrance.
